svg.title: Generating an adapter from an OpenAPI spec
svg.desc: An author starts a mapping from an OpenAPI spec with heading init, edits it, and runs heading generate to get an adapter, its suggested kinds and test data; heading test runs it against a mock API, and the passing adapter is installed in Bearing's settings, where the server runs it and stores namespaced records whose meaning comes from the operator's extends.
